newsitem.title: POLAND: Warsaw Commodity Exchange to start options trade.
newsitem.headline: Warsaw Commodity Exchange to start options trade.

text.p: Warsaw Commodity Exchange SA (WGT) will start trading wheat, rye, maize and meat options on June 2, a WGT official said on Friday.

"We are technically ready to start options trade and will hold our first session on June 2...and we plan on starting with two secondary-market sessions per week once trade gets going," WGT specialist Jan Bakowski told Reuters.
Bakowski said WGT had created its own clearing house and would be able to guarantee delivery of both money and goods.
He said one contract would amount to 20 tonnes of wheat or rye. --Wojciech Moskwa +48 22 653 9700
